senses.en: these two odd monosyllables translate the Italian word "come" (how; the first in questions, the second in answers). Behind the apparent indecipherability of the etymology lie simply the contracted forms of the verb "insegnare" (to teach) in the imperative (hortative) and the future (concessive - demonstrative).
